opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. W. D. N. Y. (Probable jurisdiction noted, 383 U. S. 904.) Motion of the State of New Hampshire for leave to participate in oral argument, as amicus curiae, granted and thirty minutes are allotted for that purpose. The Solicitor General shall be allotted an additional thirty minutes to argue on behalf of the United States.
